Product description

Why Choose CAHAYA 6 Pockets Guitar Bag for 40 41 42 Inch Guitars?

  • 6 outer pockets for extra larger storage capacity.
  • Anti-theft pocket and back pocket provide great privacy and convenience for your personal belongings.
  • The sleek spillproof oxford cloth and solid construction will keep the guitar from scratches and dirt.
  • You can carry it by hands if take it to a nearby place(handbag) or wear it with shoulders which makes your feel breezily when go hiking(backpack).

Compatible guitar models tested by our customers:

Yamaha Red Label FG's FG180,Yamaha FG800, FG230,Yamaha CG122MSH classical,Yamaha F325, Epiphone PR-150 Acoustic, Epiphone DR-100 Laminate, Blueridge Acoustic, Martin 12-string, Martin Acoustic, Gibson Les Paul Tribute, FF338, ES335, Firefly 335, Epiphone Dreadnought, Grote ES-335, Takamine Acoustic/Electric, Ibanez Artcore Semi Hollow Body Electric, Fender Coronado-II, Guild D25M, 42" Washburn, 335 Style Semi-hollowbody Electric, Taylor Acoustic 210E, Takamine Prior, etc. NOTE: THIS GUITAR BAG IS TOO SMALL FOR JUMBO ACOUSTIC GUITARS

Soft guitar gig bag with spillproof oxford cloth exterior. No need to worry about light rain.

Unique Anti-theft Pocket Design and Large Capacity Storage

  • Back pocket for phones or cables and free your hands when the bag is on your shoulder. (This pocket is a little tight but deep)
  • The new added secret pocket hiding under the handle will not be easily found. It is much safer for storing valuable personal belongings.
  • 22*4.7in pocket for portable folding music stand.
  • 5.3*4.7in pocket for guitar tuner, capo and other small accessories.
  • 9.8*14.7in pocket sheet music, tablets…
  • 9.8*14.7in pocket for guitar strap and other accessories.

Updated Version --- Thicker Padded!

Old Version: 0.31in thick sponge padding (Far more thicker than most other products on the market. But it seems that it is not enough for some customers)

New Version: 0.5in Extra thicker padding (Improved based on customers' reviews)

Note: All guitar bags for sale now are the upgraded version.

Protects your guitar from everyday knocks and bumps.

  • 43.5" x 17.9" x 4.7"
  • Thicker padding and larger pocket guitar gig bag - fits 40/41/42" acoustic and classical guitars.

  • This new version guitar bag with back hanger loop can be hung on the wall for storage and decoration.
  • Perfect for slatwall display!

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

Sharp looking, functional & light weight - 5 stars!
I’m extremely pleased with both the style and durability of this guitar bag. I chose the brown color for its sharp, classic look—and it definitely delivers. The standout feature, though, is its lightweight design with comfortable shoulder straps, making it so much easier to carry than my old heavy case. My guitar fits perfectly, and the external zippered pockets are a thoughtful touch—easily holding my tuner, picks, sheet music, and other accessories. Five stars all the way!

Lightweight but very sturdy. Includes backpack-style straps as well as a leather reinforced side handle. Quality construction, very functional and good protection with 1/2" padding. Cheap in price, but definitely NOT cheaply made! Highly recommended!!!

    Got this for my acoustic guitar. I got a gig pack. And the "gig bag" that came with was nothing more that a trash bag with a zipper. I decided to try do to the reviews and a few YouTube video reviews.

    So being on the fence I decided to try it, any would be better than said trash bag from earlier. It's definitely an upgrade. It just fits the guitar, I did measure the guitar first. The material isn't anything great. Thickness isn't much either. But is a good basic gig bag so far. This is what should have came with my guitar in the first place.

    I'm a big guy, the backpack straps get me well. Also all the pockets hold all the necessary accessories. Straps, headstock strap, picks, capos, strings, etc...

    Overall I'm happy. It does protect the better than nothing and it holds all the necessary accessories. But I did notice that I can see exposed threads were the zipper is. Like it's not going to hold very well in the long term. Don't get me wrong I wasn't expecting a premium case at a bargain price. But this type of case used to be $25 at any music store.

    Es una funda excelente. Bastante gruesa (para el tipo de funda), con una serie de bolsillo funcionales perfectos para colocar todos los accesorios necesarios para tocar. Me gustó el color también, es un tono café nogal que recuerda un poco a la madera de la tapa trasera de las guitarras. Evidentemente la mejor protección para los golpes es una funda rígida, pero si la guitarra no está expuesta a condiciones extremas, esta es una excelente opción a muy buen precio.

    Lo único que no me gustó mucho es que viene empaquetada doblada en una caja pequeña, así que tarda mucho en eliminar los pliegues y adquirir la forma extendida total. Aunque claro, es para ahorrar espacio en el envío, y es algo más bien estético, no le resta nada de funcionalidad.

    A méxico lo envían por DHL y esa paquetería se toma las fechas muy en serio, no hay entregas con días antes jajaja.

    Llega en una caja muy pequeña, por un momento creí que me estafaron jajaja, pero es que la empacan tan bien (para que no ocupe mucho espacio y sea más económico el envío) que asusta a cuálquiera.

    La pedí para una fender electroacústica y cabe perfectamente, me gustó mucho que tenga varios compartimentos, en serio bastantes, además si es gruesa como menciona la descripción.

    Los materiales se ven de buena calidad, no es la típica tela de mochila de gobierno, si creo que proteja bastante a mi guitarra.

About this Item

  • Thick Sponge: Thick sponge can prevent guitar from damage and thick adjustable straps makes it more comfortable to carry. Bag Dimension: 43.5" x 17.9" x 4.7"
  • Material: Water resistent oxford fabric last longer time which is economical, practical, convenient than the other materials. Design for long time use.
  • 6 Outer Pockets: Six pockets on the bag’s exterior provide convenient storage space for sheet music, strings, tuners, picks and other accessories.
  • Dual-Use Design: You can carry it by hands if take it to a nearby place(handbag) or wear it with shoulders which makes your feel breezily when go hiking(backpack).
  • Rugged and Protective: The sleek appearance and solid construction will keep the guitar from scratches and dirt, also the strong zipper and rubber shockproof base protect the guitar well.

Product Description

This bag fits 40/41/42" of acoustic and classical guitars. This padded guitar bag will protect your guitar from knocks and scrapes. The wear-resistant zippers with easy-grip pulls close securely, keep your accessories safe. Specifications: Weight: approx.1.69 lb Material: waterproof oxford Size:43.5 x 18 x 5 in Rubber shockproof base at the bottom
